entries.name: rusted blade
entries.description: A warden's sidearm left in the damp until it forgot its owner.

entries.name: stiletto
entries.description: A thin blade for the gap between plates and the gap between breaths.

entries.name: ritual knife
entries.description: Its edge is scored with the Eye, cut small enough to pass inspection.

entries.name: notched longsword
entries.description: Issued by the Dominion of the Preliator. The notches are not from practice.

entries.name: flail of penance
entries.description: Built for the penitent's own back. It works as well on anyone else's.

entries.name: crux gladii
entries.description: The executioner's sword-cross. Heavy with the certainty of the people who carried it.

entries.name: ironwood cudgel
entries.description: A heavy cellarman's stave banded in cold hoop-iron; bruises cleanly through mail.

entries.name: almoner's ash-staff
entries.description: Balanced ashwood notched for paces and cellar steps alike.

entries.name: processional partisan
entries.description: A broad-bladed ceremonial halberd tipped for holding tight thresholds.

entries.name: ophite seam-knife
entries.description: Slim green-bronze dirk ground for cutting loose wax seals and artery seams.

entries.name: bastion flanged mace
entries.description: Heavy iron flange stamped at the Preliator armory to crack bone and buckler.

entries.name: cinder-wire whip
entries.description: Braided iron lash soaked in furnace oil.

entries.name: ossuary bone-saw
entries.description: Frost-bitten sawtooth steel taken from an unfiled burial trench.

entries.name: tally-clerk's hatchet
entries.description: Notched to split timber coffers and audit bars with equal speed.

entries.name: margin needle
entries.description: Barely thick enough to cast a shadow; strikes with unrecorded haste.

entries.name: cantor's sun-blade
entries.description: Gilded bronze short-sword tuned to hum at choir pitch.

entries.name: salt-etched glaive
entries.description: Long cellar polearm bitten pale by brine seepage; rewards disciplined stance.

entries.name: penitent's estoc
entries.description: Unedged thrusting blade made to test ribs between audit plates.

entries.name: smelter's maul
entries.description: Balanced iron sledge warm from the slag trenches; breaks shields at a cost to parry.

entries.name: black-iron halberd
entries.description: Heavy pole-axe carried by gate sentries in the Scriptorium.

entries.name: Unwritten Edge
entries.description: A blade forged from margins torn out of Rex Mundi's ledger.

entries.name: Bell-Tongue of Quiet Teeth
entries.description: A cast bronze clapper sharpened into a short club; trades raw reach for uncanny sight and ward-breaking clarity.

entries.name: Stitcher's Iron Awl
entries.description: Uc's long repair awl; turns every unhurried parry into a clean bleed.

entries.name: Smelter's Solar Lance
entries.description: Tapping-bar pulled white-hot from the Censer Foundry; ignites foes cleanly while dulling chill.

entries.name: Threshold Cleaver
entries.description: Stamped for blocking vaulted stairs; trades swiftness for iron guard and bone-deep sunder.

entries.name: Voiceless Cantor's Sword
entries.description: Hums in zero pitch; strips radiant posture with cold Abyssal hexes.

entries.name: Cistern Harvester
entries.description: Long sickle fished out of Audit Cisterns; freezes blood and grants chill stillness.

entries.name: ashwood shortbow
entries.description: A recurved cellar-bow strung with oiled sinew. Quiet enough for ambush.

entries.name: Eye-lens focus
entries.description: A brass-mounted prism etched with the Eye. Projects spikes of uncatalogued void.

entries.name: Dominion arbalest
entries.description: A steel-prodded crossbow stamped with the Preliator's quartermark.

entries.name: sun-censer sling
entries.description: A swinging brass censer that hurls embers of the false sun across the hall.

entries.name: abyssal rod
entries.description: Cold black glass bound in silver thread; answers Will with sharp metaphysical bolts.

entries.name: braided leather sling
entries.description: Simple silent sling made from bootlaces and cellar twine.

entries.name: audit windlass bow
entries.description: Compact iron windlass made to punch ledger shields cleanly.

entries.name: ophite seam-tube
entries.description: Narrow hollow reed that spits barbed void-salted slivers.

entries.name: ash-brazier baton
entries.description: Charred oak baton filled with dry cinder-dust.

entries.name: grave-horn bow
entries.description: Bone-backed shortbow steeped in cistern rime; slows pursuing sentries.

entries.name: marshal's repeater bow
entries.description: Balanced dual-latched bow built for hallway suppressing volleys.

entries.name: false-sun mirror bow
entries.description: Twin tilted prisms that snap harsh radiant needles across choirs.

entries.name: index glass sceptre
entries.description: Scholar's brass pointer etched with marginalia; focuses sight and Will.

entries.name: heavy rampart arbalest
entries.description: Armored stirrup crossbow built for anchored defense.

entries.name: unlined yew longbow
entries.description: Bare unvarnished stave carried past the customs posts; quick and far-reaching.

entries.name: shuttered beacon staff
entries.description: Hooded focus that flares only when its carrier opens the slide.

entries.name: Serpent's Recurver
entries.description: A bone-laminated bow carved along the Serpent's seam; every shaft carries the Hex.

entries.name: Hesper's Procession Crossbow
entries.description: Finely zeroed steel crossbow with a folding peep-sight; adds 2 tiles of clear reach and heavy sunder.

entries.name: Calix's Refracting Prism
entries.description: Cut from clean church glass; bends false sunlight back as exposing judgment.

entries.name: Ferrant's Ink-Spindle
entries.description: A hollow binding stylus that fires black void threads along hidden seams.

entries.name: Brass Flue Horn
entries.description: Belches roaring smelter sparks down narrow vaults while keeping the shooter's powder dry.

entries.name: Shut-Chapel Hail Slinger
entries.description: Cold tin tube packed with salt-ice splinters; chills pursuers without drawing attention.

entries.name: Unfiled Repeater
entries.description: Unstamped cellar bow with shaved bone cams; light enough to slip steps away cleanly.

entries.name: ash robe
entries.description: Grey wool that takes the colour of whatever wall you stand against.

entries.name: leather jerkin
entries.description: Boiled leather, patched by three owners.

entries.name: chain hauberk
entries.description: Dominion mail with the porphyry dye scrubbed out.

entries.name: witness mantle
entries.description: Tide-dyed cloak worn by watchers of the Eye; turns void aside.

entries.name: preliator plate
entries.description: Black iron plate of the armed church. It slows the body and steadies the nerve.

entries.name: bastion brigandine
entries.description: Riveted leather over overlapping gatehouse iron plates.

entries.name: clerk's heavy greatcoat
entries.description: Waxed wool lined with stamped lead tokens along the hem.

entries.name: ophite seam-coat
entries.description: Dark oilcloth stitched along double inner pockets.

entries.name: ashen penitent coat
entries.description: Coarse woven wool soaked in chimney lye; sheds ember sparks cleanly.

entries.name: velvet ossuary coat
entries.description: Faded crimson velvet lined against cistern frost.

entries.name: archive keeper's habit
entries.description: Quiet grey wool sewn with lantern-lens pockets.

entries.name: processional half-plate
entries.description: Burnished breastplate lighter than full preliator iron.

entries.name: unlined runner's cloak
entries.description: Paler underneath than above, stitched without guild marks.

entries.name: gilded cantor's vestment
entries.description: Stiff choir silk woven over brass thread; turns false sun rays aside.

entries.name: cellar-almoner's leather
entries.description: Heavy stitched apron worn by broth-tenders and bottle-washers.

entries.name: foundry scale coat
entries.description: Overlapping bronze scales scavenged from cooling ladles.

entries.name: Cowl of the First Witness
entries.description: Woven where Lilith left the record; neither false sun nor void blinds its wearer.

entries.name: Odo's Night-Cart Greatcoat
entries.description: Heavy oiled driver's coat; trades bulk for speed and unseen evasion in dark lanes.

entries.name: Iron Gatekeeper's Harness
entries.description: Double-plated Dominion harness; turns arrows and frost aside at a heavy pace.

entries.name: Shut-Chapel Altar Pall
entries.description: Moth-worn sanctuary cloth washed in salt; shields Will against every Chain.

entries.name: Sun-House Stoker's Mantle
entries.description: Woven mineral cloth impervious to false-sun sparks and chimney flames.

entries.name: Audited Chain of Seals
entries.description: Every link bears an official cancellation mark; crisp precision without slack.

entries.name: Eye of Lilith
entries.description: An unblinking witness. It catalogs nothing; it shows you what is there.

entries.name: broken tithe seal
entries.description: The wax seal of a debt that was never paid. Somehow, it holds you together.

entries.name: gatekeeper's brass tally
entries.description: Heavy iron neck-badge issued to post sentries.

entries.name: audit weight medallion
entries.description: Counterbalance weight pierced for a cord; steadies the striking hand.

entries.name: green-bronze serpent coil
entries.description: Braided green copper wire that chills false light away from the throat.

entries.name: penitent cinder-beads
entries.description: Vitrified ash beads strung on waxed flax.

entries.name: ossuary bone locket
entries.description: Holds a chip of unlabeled marble and keeps grave-chill away.

entries.name: archivist's cord loupe
entries.description: Ground spectacle lens hung around the neck for reading dim inscriptions.

entries.name: marshal's copper gorget
entries.description: Fluted collar worn during Processional District musters.

entries.name: folded margin charm
entries.description: Blank vellum clipped from an audited ledger; lightens the step.

entries.name: choir brass sunburst
entries.description: Twelve-rayed brass disk that steadies Will in radiant chambers.

entries.name: cistern salt-charm
entries.description: Fused ring of mineral salt hung in leather; guards against foul vapor.

entries.name: chipped porphyry signet
entries.description: Old Dominion ring worn on a neck-thong after the wearer deserted.

entries.name: mute bone whistle
entries.description: Carved hollow so no sentry hears it, yet your aim locks cleanly.

entries.name: cracked exemption token
entries.description: A red wax impression stamped with half a pardon.

entries.name: cellar iron-needle
entries.description: Points neither north nor toward the Sun-Houses, only away from walls.

entries.name: Chainbreaker Seal
entries.description: A shattered iron signet that refuses every chain's signature.

entries.name: Clerk Anselm's Voided Die
entries.description: Heavy bronze stamp defaced with a file; voids radiant seals and sharpens unseen counters.

entries.name: Wren's Latch-Chain
entries.description: Three brass door-tokens strung by the Hidden Assemblies; opens sight through darkness.

entries.name: Almoner Dessa's Pan-Weight
entries.description: Measured exactly once per breath; trades armor heft for resilience and deadly balance.

entries.name: Choir-Coal Medallion
entries.description: Warm iron cage holding an ash-ember that never goes out.

entries.name: Mirande's Silent Pendant
entries.description: Tear of smoky quartz from the Closed Stacks; hastens Will and footwork together.

entries.name: healing salve
entries.description: Tallow, yarrow and a little honest work. Closes shallow wounds.

entries.name: bone tincture
entries.description: Bitter, cold and slow to act, but it mends what salve cannot.

entries.name: vial of false light
entries.description: Liquid relief from the false sun. It helps at once. Then it collects.

entries.name: salted cellar cordial
entries.description: Warm herb decoction corked in Day-House cellars for fever and knife-cuts.

entries.name: sanctuary resin draught
entries.description: Pine pitch boiled in clean well-water; closes deep gashes reliably.

entries.name: deep-marrow elixir
entries.description: Thick red apothecary distillate capable of knitting cracked ribs in seconds.

entries.name: quicksilver draught
entries.description: Sharp metallic liquor that speeds footwork for ten turns.

entries.name: iron-bark decoction
entries.description: Tannic brew that thickens skin and turns blades for twelve turns.

entries.name: quiet-veil tincture
entries.description: Dulls footsteps and silhouette against sentry lanterns.

entries.name: witness-eye wash
entries.description: Cool herbal wash granting +2 sight, +2 accuracy, and +2 Will.

entries.name: wormwood temper-phial
entries.description: Bitter anti-elemental draught shielding against fire, cold, and void.

entries.name: foundry-pepper dram
entries.description: Fierce spirit trading a sliver of guard for +3 strike damage.

entries.name: unsealed choir wine
entries.description: Sour cellar vintage granting Apostate Focus against radiant overseers.

entries.name: chapel-well flask
entries.description: Pure cistern water imparting Sanctuary Ward's calm defense.

entries.name: confessor's eye-drops
entries.description: Stinging lens-wash granting sharp accuracy and extended sight.

entries.name: green-salt phial
entries.description: Crystalline ophite brine conferring keen evasion and critical precision.

entries.name: almoner's spice-tonic
entries.description: Warm broth concentrate that knits minor wounds over eight turns.

entries.name: ward-oil cordial
entries.description: Pale medicinal oil granting sharp vision and resistance to fire and cold.

entries.name: throwing knife
entries.description: A balanced steel dart meant for corridors. Inflicts Bleeding on impact.

entries.name: iron javelin
entries.description: Heavy Dominion throwing spear that punches open shields and inflicts Sundered.

entries.name: cinder flask
entries.description: Alchemical pitch that bursts in a 1-tile fire blast, igniting foes.

entries.name: ossuary rime vial
entries.description: Bottled grave-frost that slows its target with Chilled.

entries.name: false sun prism
entries.description: A brittle condenser of solar geometry; deals Radiant damage and Hexes the target.

entries.name: barbed cellar dart
entries.description: Thin weighted flechette that flies far and opens a stubborn bleed.

entries.name: leaden bolas
entries.description: Twin cords weighted with audit lead; pins rushing hunters in place.

entries.name: rock-salt canister
entries.description: Clay pot packed with scrap spikes; blasts a 1-tile circle and sunders guards.

entries.name: cistern frost-pot
entries.description: Freezing brine shell that bursts across a 1-tile zone, chilling packs.

entries.name: void-glass splinter
entries.description: Black obsidian sliver that pierces armor and inflicts Hexed.

entries.name: hollowed void-sphere
entries.description: Fragile glass orb of uncatalogued air; bursts in a 1-tile Void concussion.

entries.name: solar flare bulb
entries.description: Blinding church flare that burns across 1 tile and leaves foes Exposed.

entries.name: silvered quarry bolt
entries.description: Heavy hand-thrown quarry bolt; strikes cleanly through thick hide.

entries.name: furnace slag bead
entries.description: Hot iron pellet wrapped in oiled rag; sets single targets ablaze from afar.

entries.name: scroll of phase step
entries.description: Steps cleanly sideways out of the Geometry to any visible tile within 5 steps.

entries.name: scroll of abyssal lance
entries.description: Fires a piercing beam of Void along a line, striking every foe in its path.

entries.name: scroll of cinder ward
entries.description: Unleashes a ring of Fire around you within 2 tiles and grants Braced.

entries.name: scroll of witness
entries.description: Reveals every unidentified item, potion, scroll, and curse in your pack.

entries.name: scroll of unbinding
entries.description: Breaks every curse binding your gear (or blesses an equipped piece if none are cursed).

entries.name: scroll of sanctuary ward
entries.description: Grants Sanctuary Ward (+4 defense, +20% radiant & void resist), mends wounds, and eases Subjugation.

entries.name: scroll of stricken docket
entries.description: Strips active Chain debuffs and lowers Subjugation pressure by 2.

entries.name: scroll of cellar survey
entries.description: Maps corridors and exposes traps, secrets, and sites within 18 tiles.

entries.name: scroll of transposition
entries.description: Swaps places across the Geometry with the nearest visible foe within 6 steps.

entries.name: scroll of ossuary frost
entries.description: Sweeps cold through all visible foes within 3 tiles and leaves them Chilled.

entries.name: scroll of false dawn
entries.description: Floods 4 tiles around you with exposing radiant glare.

entries.name: scroll of chalk binding
entries.description: Pins visible foes within 3 tiles in Void geometry.

entries.name: scroll of iron template
entries.description: Clears Sundered and grants Iron-Tempered Skin for 12 turns.

entries.name: scroll of swift cadence
entries.description: Accelerates your pace (+30 speed, +2 evasion) for 10 turns.

entries.name: scroll of deep breath
entries.description: Restores 3d4+4 HP and +6 class resource in a single turn.

entries.name: scroll of chalk sanctuary
entries.description: Redraws surrounding tiles into consecrated Sanctuary stone.

entries.name: scroll of void warrant
entries.description: Hurls the nearest non-boss foe across the chamber (or strikes bosses with Void).

entries.name: scroll of quiet shroud
entries.description: Wraps you in Veiled stillness and Quiet Shroud (+4 evasion, +10% crit).

entries.name: scroll of furnace draft
entries.description: Sweeps scorching furnace embers across visible foes within 3 tiles.

entries.name: scroll of unsigned tally
entries.description: Clears Reckoning and Forsworn penalties and kindles Apostate Focus.

entries.name: Confessor's Glass
entries.description: A lensground pane from an old confessional. Looking through it hurts the eyes and leaves nothing hidden.
entries.work_desc: Pay 3 HP: +3 accuracy, +3 sight for 12 turns (clears fog).

entries.name: Ophite Key
entries.description: A cold bronze key bitten by green salt. It turns in locks that have no door.
entries.work_desc: Pay 3 HP: +3 evasion, +15% crit for 12 turns.

entries.name: Broken Halo
entries.description: Half a crown of gilt iron, snapped clean across the brow.
entries.work_desc: Pay 4 HP: +3 defense, +1 damage for 12 turns.
entries.transmute_desc: Destroy relic: permanently +6 max HP, +1 defense.

entries.name: Severed Crown
entries.description: An iron circlet cleft cleanly through the sovereign seal.
entries.work_desc: Pay 4 HP: +3 damage, +2 accuracy, +25% radiant resist for 10 turns.
entries.transmute_desc: Destroy relic: permanently +1 might, +1 will, +1 damage.

entries.name: Ward-Keeper's Lamp
entries.description: A shuttered oil lantern that still remembers who walked the corridor first.
entries.work_desc: Pay 2 HP: +3 sight, +25% fire & cold resist, clears fog, identifies pack.
entries.transmute_desc: Destroy relic: permanently +1 sight, +1 defense, +4 max HP.

entries.name: Almoner's Purse
entries.description: A salt-stained leather pouch heavy with leaden debt-tokens.
entries.work_desc: No HP cost: regenerate +2/turn, +2 evasion for 8 turns, restore +4 resource.
entries.transmute_desc: Destroy relic: permanently +8 max HP, +5 speed.

entries.name: Penitent's Brass Scourge
entries.description: Tarnished discipline cord from the Shut Chapel; cuts hard when worked in blood.
entries.work_desc: Pay 4 HP: +3 damage, +15% crit, +20% radiant resist for 10 turns.

entries.name: Archive Index Lens
entries.description: Brass-rimmed reading glass from the Closed Stacks that spots hidden seams and ink.
entries.work_desc: Pay 2 HP: +3 sight, +2 accuracy for 14 turns and reveal sites within 6 tiles.

entries.name: Sanctuary Ash Reliquary
entries.description: Copper box filled with cool furnace cinders from a razed parish.
entries.work_desc: Pay 3 HP: +2 damage, +40% fire & +20% cold resist for 12 turns.
entries.transmute_desc: Destroy relic: permanently +1 damage, +4 max HP.

entries.name: Velvet-Clapper Rime Bell
entries.description: Bronze handbell damp with ossuary frost; one mute toll stills close pursuers.
entries.work_desc: Pay 3 HP: +2 defense/evasion, +40% cold resist for 10 turns and chill nearby foes.

entries.name: Unwritten Margin Leaf
entries.description: Heavy linen sheet cut out before a decree was stamped; deflects the Chains.
entries.work_desc: Pay 3 HP: +3 evasion, +2 will, +30% void resist for 12 turns and ease Subjugation.

entries.name: Counterfeit Sun Sovereign
entries.description: Lead-core coin washed in false gilt; mocks Dominion seals cleanly.
entries.work_desc: Pay 3 HP: +3 accuracy, +2 damage, +35% radiant resist for 10 turns.

entries.name: Cellar Salt-Glass
entries.description: Timed with brine-salt instead of sand; buys steps when pursuit closes.
entries.work_desc: Pay 2 HP: +25 speed, +2 evasion for 8 turns and restore +3 resource.

entries.name: Cantor's Brass Tuning-Fork
entries.description: Rings below speech; breaks dissonance in choir ambushes.
entries.work_desc: Pay 3 HP: +2 will, +2 accuracy, +25% void resist for 12 turns.

entries.name: Preliator Gatekeeper Seal
entries.description: Heavy iron stamp taken from a collapsed post; anchors the carrier in narrow doors.
entries.work_desc: Pay 3 HP: +4 defense, +25% physical resist for 10 turns.
entries.transmute_desc: Destroy relic: permanently +2 defense, +4 max HP.

entries.name: Pocket Mirror of the Eye
entries.description: Silvered pocket glass cracked down the corner; strips perceptual fog on sight.
entries.work_desc: Pay 2 HP: +2 sight, +2 evasion, +15% crit for 12 turns and clear fog.

entries.name: vault key
entries.description: A heavy black-iron key stamped with a vault ledger number.

entries.name: numbered archive pass-key
entries.description: Brass ward-key from the Closed Stacks that turns Dominion vault locks cleanly.

entries.name: unfiled cellar pick-key
entries.description: A filed-down iron blank carried by runners between unrecorded doors.
